name: project-ines-content-accuracy
description: Factual framing rules for copy on Ines Okafor's (Saltmarsh) portfolio site — dates, waste stat, Fjaerland role
metadata:
  type: project
---

Specific facts Ines corrected that must be preserved in any copy for her portfolio site:

- Fjaerland (Norway) was a **stage**: ten weeks, unpaid. She washed jars, labelled them, and helped on two batches of garum. Do NOT frame this as a research role or imply more seniority than that — she was explicit she doesn't want it to sound like she was a researcher there.
- The food-waste stat (14 kg → 5 kg a week) is for the **whole kitchen**, weighed over one month in 2023, and covers **prep and plate waste only** — bones are excluded (they go to stock). Write this as "we" cut waste, not "I".
- Head Chef dates: she was **acting** head chef from March 2022, and got the formal title in **September 2022**. Use September 2022 as the date for "Head Chef", not March 2022 (March 2022 can be used for when she started running the kitchen, if that distinction is drawn).
- Do not display supplier pricing anywhere on the site.
- Do not show staff faces unless Ines has explicitly asked them first (none have been cleared as of 2026-10-10).

**Why:** These are legal/reputational accuracy points Ines raised unprompted — getting them wrong misrepresents her experience or exposes her/staff/suppliers.
**How to apply:** Check any generated copy about Fjaerland, the waste stat, or the Head Chef date against this before publishing. Related: [[project-ines-image-rights]], [[project-ines-audience]].

input.content:
---
name: project-ines-audience
description: Intended audience and operational backbone (prep list + ferment log) for Ines Okafor's portfolio site
metadata:
  type: project
---

The site is for **prospective apprentices, food writers, and people booking her workshops** — Ines is explicitly not looking for a job, so avoid any "hire me" / recruiter-facing framing. CTAs should point toward applying for the apprentice programme, press/media contact, or workshop booking.

Operationally, the kitchen runs on the **prep list** and the **ferment log** (date a jar was started, the salt %, the days it's checked, when it's ready) — the menu is written last each week, not first. This is a good structural motif for the site's interactive/visual centerpiece (e.g. the jar-wall section), more accurate than treating the menu as the starting point.

**Why:** Framing and CTAs need to match who's actually meant to read the site; the prep-list/ferment-log detail is the real mechanism behind her work and makes for more authentic interactive content than a generic "menu-first" framing.
**How to apply:** Write copy and CTAs for apprentices/writers/workshop-bookers. When designing the jar-wall/ferment interactive piece, surface ferment-log fields (start date, salt %, check days, ready date) rather than inventing generic labels. Related: [[project-ines-content-accuracy]].

Saved those as corrections for the build. Updated plan:

## Revised content & framing

**Experience timeline** — corrected:
- Chef de Partie, Brassica, Manchester (2016–2019)
- **Stage, Fjaerland Fermentation Lab, Norway** — ten weeks, unpaid: washing and labelling jars, helped on two batches of garum. No "lab researcher" framing.
- Sous Chef, The Corn Exchange Kitchen, Leeds (2019–2022)
- Acting Head Chef from March 2022 → **Head Chef, Saltmarsh, from September 2022** (use Sept 2022 as the title date)

**Stats section** — reworded: "**we** cut prep and plate waste from 14kg to 5kg a week, weighed over a month in 2023" (whole kitchen, not her alone; bones excluded — they go to stock). No supplier pricing anywhere.

**Imagery** — Priya's ~60 restaurant/jar-wall photos go in with a visible credit line. Olu's Brine drawings are **held back** until Ines confirms with him — I'll build that section with placeholders. Her own phone photos and the ogiri-pot photo are clear to use freely. No staff faces unless she's individually cleared them (none yet).

**Audience & tone shift** — this is not a "hire me" site. CTAs should be: apply for the apprentice programme, press/media enquiries, book a workshop. Drop anything that reads recruiter-facing.

**New structural motif** — swap the generic "menu first" framing for the real mechanism: the **prep list** and the **ferment log** (start date, salt %, check-in days, ready date) are what actually drive the kitchen; the menu is written last each week. This should be the content behind the jar-wall interactive — each jar's label on hover shows its actual ferment-log fields rather than a generic description.

**FAQ section** keeps Ines's own answers verbatim where possible (e.g. "the koji room — it's a cupboard") to preserve her voice.

Section order and tech stack from the first plan still stand. Let me know if this reads right, and whether you want me to start scaffolding with placeholder imagery or wait on anything else.
